opportunities.title: NYDA Grant Programme
opportunities.opportunity_type: Youth enterprise grant and business development support
opportunities.eligibility: South African citizens aged 18–35 with relevant or potential enterprise skills; additional business criteria and exclusions apply.
opportunities.location: South Africa; check the NYDA branch or portal for service access.
opportunities.application_status: Programme information available; no fixed closing date stated
opportunities.closing_date: No closing date stated on the official programme page.
opportunities.summary: Financial and non-financial support for eligible young entrepreneurs. Confirm the full criteria and current application process with NYDA.

opportunities.title: MICT SETA 2027/28 Discretionary Grant
opportunities.provider: Media, Information and Communication Technologies Sector Education and Training Authority (MICT SETA)
opportunities.eligibility: The current MICT SETA notice invites eligible stakeholders in the Media and ICT sub-sectors. It does not identify individual learners as direct applicants.
opportunities.location: Media and ICT sub-sectors; the notice does not state a geographic restriction.
opportunities.application_status: Funding window open to eligible stakeholders as verified 14 November 2026
opportunities.closing_date: 30 November 2026, midnight (timezone not stated by the notice).
opportunities.summary: A stakeholder funding window, not an individual learner grant. Recheck the official notice and detailed programme requirements before applying.

opportunities.title: MICT SETA Learnerships
opportunities.eligibility: The MICT SETA page describes learnerships as an entry into the industry for unemployed learners. Specific criteria are set by the recruiting employer and training provider.
opportunities.location: Varies by employer, service provider and training provider.
opportunities.application_status: Guidance page; no general learner intake listed
opportunities.closing_date: No general closing date stated on the official information page.
opportunities.summary: MICT SETA facilitates programmes, while employers and service or training providers recruit learners. Check their individual notices for open positions.

opportunities.title: SEDA Business Support Services
opportunities.opportunity_type: Business advice, training, consultancy and mentorship
opportunities.eligibility: Entrepreneurs with a business idea and existing entrepreneurs or small enterprises; specific services may have their own criteria.
opportunities.location: South Africa; access depends on SEDA's service network and the particular service.
opportunities.application_status: Ongoing service information; not a grant or confirmed funding offer
opportunities.summary: SEDA provides non-financial business support. Contact SEDA to confirm the right service and whether it is available in your area.

opportunities.title: MICT SETA Skills Programmes
opportunities.opportunity_type: Media, information and ICT sector skills programme information
opportunities.eligibility: The page says programmes are implemented by employers for employed and unemployed learners. Check the specific employer or accredited provider for entry criteria.
opportunities.location: Set by each employer and training provider; no general location is listed.
opportunities.application_status: Guidance page; no current learner intake listed
opportunities.closing_date: No general closing date stated on the official information page.
opportunities.summary: Information about sector skills programmes, not a live AI course listing. Confirm the exact digital or ICT programme, accreditation and intake with its provider.
